entities.name: Teval
entities.description: Mythic Spirit Dragon of the Sultai Brood on Tarkir, a fair and impartial judge of the clan.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Clan on Tarkir that Teval arbitrates.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Performed the Stormnexus Ritual after which Teval formed herself.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Static dragon whom Teval is contrasted with.

entities.description: Sultai leader whose power Teval checks.

events.summary: Narset performs the Stormnexus Ritual and Kotis calls Teval forth, and Teval forms herself as the Sultai's impartial judge.
events.quote: she formed herself after Narset performed the Stormnexus Ritual and Kotis called her forth

relations.note: She arbitrates the clan, checking its leaders.
relations.quote: Teval's primary role is not to lead the Sultai but to arbitrate the clan
